At 390x844 all four collapse to one 358.4px column, the rail becomes position:static below the content at full width, and the document does not overflow. The modal-bar guard is now ROLE-based so a Tailwind-classed bar cannot escape it; the cockpit guard is POPULATIONAL over the whole loaded runtime (4 cockpits, 4 rails, 0 unmarked) instead of asserting one file.
